name: Japanese · Phrases · School and class
source: Phrases: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org) sentences written by native speakers, each linked in its src; lines marked generated were written for Lianki and checked for natural use

entries.reading: しつもんはありますか
entries.note: Said by the teacher at the end of an explanation.

entries.term: もう一度言っていただけますか？
entries.reading: もういちどいっていただけますか
entries.note: Asking a teacher to repeat. Polite and safe.

entries.term: もっとゆっくり話してください。
entries.reading: もっとゆっくりはなしてください
entries.note: Every learner's lifeline in a language class.

entries.reading: どういういみですか
entries.note: Asking about a word or what the teacher just said.

entries.term: すみません、聞こえませんでした。
entries.reading: すみませんきこえませんでした
entries.note: When you missed what was said in class.

entries.reading: おくれてすみません
entries.note: Said as you slip into class after it started.

entries.reading: はいわかりました
entries.note: Answering a teacher's instruction.

entries.term: 先生、この文は合ってますか？
entries.reading: せんせいこのぶんはあってますか
entries.note: Checking your writing with the teacher.

entries.reading: ではじゅぎょうをはじめます
entries.note: Teacher's opening line for the lesson.

entries.reading: しゅっせきをとります
entries.note: Teacher line before calling names. Answer はい when called.

entries.term: 教科書を開いてください。
entries.reading: きょうかしょをひらいてください
entries.note: Teacher instruction; usually followed by a page number.

entries.reading: しずかにしてください
entries.note: Teacher to a noisy class.

entries.reading: しゅくだいおわった
entries.note: Classmates or a parent asking.

entries.term: やばい、宿題やってない。
entries.reading: やばいしゅくだいやってない
entries.back: Crap, I didn't do my homework.
entries.note: Panicking to a classmate just before class.

entries.reading: しゅくだいをわすれました
entries.note: Owning up to the teacher.

entries.term: 今日のテストどうだった？
entries.reading: きょうのテストどうだった
entries.note: Classmates after an exam, or a parent at home.

entries.term: 明日の英語って宿題あったっけ？
entries.reading: あしたのえいごってしゅくだいあったっけ
entries.back: Was there homework for English tomorrow?
entries.note: Double-checking with a classmate. Swap 英語 for any subject.

entries.term: 今回テスト範囲広くない？
entries.reading: こんかいテストはんいひろくない
entries.back: Isn't there way too much on this test?
entries.note: Moaning with classmates about what the exam covers.

entries.term: 試験勉強をしなくちゃ。
entries.reading: しけんべんきょうをしなくちゃ
entries.back: I need to study for the exam.
entries.note: Turning down plans, or telling yourself off.

entries.term: ノート見せてくれない？
entries.reading: ノートみせてくれない
entries.note: Asking a classmate after you missed a class.

entries.term: 先生に聞いてみようよ。
entries.reading: せんせいにきいてみようよ
entries.note: When you and a classmate are both stuck.

entries.reading: このかんじなんてよむの
entries.back: How do you read this kanji?
entries.note: Asking a classmate or friend about a character.

entries.term: 新しいクラスには慣れた？
entries.reading: あたらしいクラスにはなれた
entries.note: Asked early in the school year by friends or family.

entries.reading: がくしょくはあきちゃった
entries.back: I'm sick of the cafeteria food.
entries.note: Student chat at lunchtime. 学食 = school cafeteria.

entries.term: この授業、サボっちゃおうかな。
entries.reading: このじゅぎょうサボっちゃおうかな
entries.note: Half-joking to a friend. サボる = skip, slack off.

entries.reading: レポートもうだした
entries.back: Did you hand in the paper yet?
entries.note: University students checking on an assignment.

entries.reading: たんいおとしそう
entries.back: I think I'm going to fail this course.
entries.note: University worry; 単位 = course credit.

entries.reading: せんこうはなんですか
entries.note: Getting to know a university student.

entries.reading: なんねんせい
entries.note: Asking a student, often a kid or a fellow student.

entries.reading: ほうかごなにする
entries.back: What are you doing after school?
entries.note: Making plans with friends at school.

entries.reading: しけんがんばってね
entries.note: Encouraging a friend before a test.
